idea-plugin.name: GitDiffBatch
idea-plugin.description:
A Painfully Real Scenario: Manual Code Merge in IntelliJ IDEA

If you use IntelliJ IDEA (or any JetBrains IDE) and frequently need to manually merge code, you have almost certainly experienced this workflow.

🧠 The Typical Workflow

In the Git Log window:
  • 🔍 Search a set of commits by keyword, author, or time range
  • You want to understand what these commits actually changed
  • 👉 Right-click and choose “Show Diff with Working Tree”
IDEA shows a list of all changed files. Now comes the painful part 😵 You want to review each file one by one in its own tab, so you must:
  • Find a file in the diff list
  • Right-click → “Show Diff in a New Tab”
  • Go back to Git Log
  • Find the next file
  • Repeat… again and again
For dozens of files, this constant jumping between Git Log and Diff completely breaks your focus.

💡 GitDiffBatch: Built Exactly to Solve This Problem

GitDiffBatch has one very clear goal:

Open diffs for all files involved in selected commits — in separate tabs — at once.

No more clicking file by file. No more context switching.

🚀 A Better Workflow

With GitDiffBatch:
  1. Open Git Log
  2. Select the commits you want to review or manually merge (multi-select supported)
  3. 👉 Trigger Batch Show Diff
✨ All related file diffs are automatically opened:
  • Each file in its own tab
  • Clear order
  • Ready for continuous review
You only need to focus on one thing:

Review the code and decide how to merge.

✨ Why This Matters for Manual Merging

🧠 1. Continuous Thinking
Review diffs like flipping pages in a book: one tab after another, without interruptions.

⚡ 2. Dramatically Higher Efficiency
No repetitive right-clicks.
No jumping between Git Log and Diff.
The improvement is especially obvious with dozens of files.

🛡️ 3. Safer Manual Merges
Manual merges fail when changes are missed.
GitDiffBatch puts all relevant diffs in front of you, making hidden changes and potential conflicts much easier to spot.

🧩 In Summary

This is a capability that IDEA should have — but doesn’t. If you often:
  • Select a batch of commits in Git Log
  • Need to manually review or merge changes
  • Want all related file diffs opened in separate tabs at once
GitDiffBatch is a must-have plugin.

🚀 How to Use

  1. In the "Settings/Preferences" menu, navigate to "Tools" > "GitDiffBatch". Within this section, you can toggle the comparison target on the right side: compare the selected commit or the latest commit of the selected branch.
  2. The "Annotate with Git Blame" feature is now supported for comparing versions on both sides.
  3. Select commits in Git Log (multi-select supported)
  4. Right-click → Batch Show Diff
  5. All related diffs open in tabs and can be reviewed or merged into the current branch

🧩 一个真实到不能再真实的场景：IDEA 里的人工代码合并

如果你使用 IntelliJ IDEA（或其它 JetBrains IDE），并且经常需要进行 人工合并代码，那你大概率经历过下面这个流程。

🧠 实际工作流程

在 Git Log 窗口中：

  • 🔍 通过关键字 / 作者 / 时间范围搜索出 一批提交
  • 为了搞清楚这些提交都改了什么
  • 👉 右键选择 Show Diff with Working Tree

IDEA 会把 所有有差异的文件 一次性列出来。

你开始人工分析：

  • 哪些文件需要合并
  • 哪些可以忽略
  • 哪些存在潜在的冲突风险

接下来是最痛苦的部分 😵

你希望 逐个文件在独立 Tab 中对比代码，于是你只能：

  • 在 Diff 列表中找到一个文件
  • 右键 👉 Show Diff in a New Tab
  • 再回到 Git Log
  • 再找这个提交到底改了哪个文件
  • 重复 N 次……

👉 每一个文件都要点一遍，每一次都要在 Git Log 和 Diff 之间来回跳转。

💡 GitDiffBatch：就是为了解决这个问题而生的

GitDiffBatch 解决的正是这个核心需求：

能不能直接从 Git Log 里，把这批提交涉及的所有文件，一次性打开 Diff？

答案是：可以。

🎯 GitDiffBatch 能做什么

  • 👉 从 Git Log 中选中 多个提交
  • 👉 使用 GitDiffBatch 提供的 批量 Diff 操作
  • 👉 所有相关文件的 Diff 自动打开
  • 👉 每个文件一个独立 Tab

无需反复点击，无需来回跳转，只需专注于代码本身。

🔍 使用方法

  1. 增加设置Settings/Preferences > Tools > GitDiffBatch 里切换右侧对比目标：比对选中的提交或选中分支的最新提交
  2. 左右对比版本已支持Annotate with Git Blame功能
  3. 选中需要对比或人工合并的提交记录（支持多选）
  4. 右键菜单中点击 Batch Show Diff
  5. 选中的差异文件会全部在独立 Tab 中展示，可直接 Review 并合入当前分支

GitDiffBatch 是一个专为 人工合并 / 人工代码审查 场景打造的效率插件， 让你把时间真正花在 理解代码变化 上，而不是重复的点击操作。
